tolerance_basis: p99 of |r_t - (holdings_price_return + income_return)| over 1098 reconciled account-days
plausibility_band_basis: the data's own p0.1 (-0.091352) or p99.9 (1.081737) reaches the PRD's default band, so the band is REPORTED against the default rather than silently widened -- a widening is the CTO's, not this cell's.
_SUPERSEDED: DO NOT USE. These numbers were measured BEFORE the in-kind flow fix, so every F_t behind them omitted securities transfers -- including the ACAT transfers that open four of the six sample accounts ($0.5M-$2.1M each). The tolerance and band they carry are therefore distributions of a defect, not of the method. Kept as the evidence that the first pass was unusable; the live filename is deliberately absent so the producer REFUSES an emit rather than reading these.
